topic: Trying Samples at a Warehouse Store

script.title: SAMPLES AT THE WAREHOUSE STORE
script.scene_zh: 會員大賣場 · 試吃攤位
script.story_hook: Free samples start a very big plan.
script.intro_zh: 一口試吃，引爆一場超大採購計畫。
script.welcome_en: Hi there, welcome to today's episode! We're tasting samples at a giant store.
script.welcome_zh: 哈囉，歡迎收看今天這集！我們到超大賣場試吃。
script.outro: Full tummy, smart shopper. That's all for today!
script.outro_zh: 肚子飽飽，聰明採購。今天就到這裡！
script.practice_intro_en: Now echo each sentence, just like at the booth.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在像在試吃攤前一樣，跟我一句一句唸。

script.char_b_description: a sturdy man in his thirties with a neat ginger beard and buzz cut, wearing a warehouse club vest over a flannel shirt, waving tongs over the sample grill
script.youtube_title: 【🧀大賣場試吃英文】😋「全部都能免費吃？」🎟️來客證與大包裝一次搞懂｜Warehouse Samples English
script.youtube_title_en: “Is All This Food Free To Try?” — Samples at a Warehouse Store
script.youtube_description:
第一次逛會員大賣場，試吃台能不能隨便吃？這段熱鬧又實用的對話幫你解鎖！在試吃攤位前，跟著 Bea 一起問試吃規則、認識會員制度與來客證、搞懂大包裝採購單位。整段 18 句美式日常英語，附上繁體中文翻譯與 IPA 標音，後半段逐句跟讀，聽一遍就會開口用。
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
訂閱我們的頻道，每天一集，讓英語變成你的直覺！
script.youtube_description_en:
First time at a warehouse club, eyeing the sample booth? This lively dialogue answers the big question: is it free? Follow Bea through sampling rules, guest passes, and giant-size shopping for an office potluck — 18 lines of everyday American English with IPA, plus line-by-line repeat practice in the second half.
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new episode every day!
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🧀賣場試吃英文｜試吃台規則・來客證申請・大包裝採購｜聽完就會用｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
試吃攤的料理，真的可以隨便拿嗎？
沒有會員卡，今天這圈還能逛嗎？

這一集帶大家走進會員大賣場的試吃攤位，Bea 從問清試吃規則、聊到大包裝的分量，再順便學會申請一日來客證，全程都是熱鬧自然的美式口語。

你會聽到：
🧀 問試吃規則：例如「is all this food free to try?」、「can I grab a skewer myself?」。
🎟️ 會員證與來客證：例如「can I shop without a membership?」、「three per family, first come basis」。
📦 大包裝與收尾：例如「we sell them in the giant tubs」、「then the big box wins, trust me」。

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把整段對話變成自然的口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

下次路過試吃攤，勇敢舉起牙籤，也舉起你的英文！
script.thumbnail_action: taking a sample skewer from the tray
script.title_quote: is all this food free to try

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Excuse me, is all this food free to try?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪkˈskjuːz miː ɪz ɔːl ðɪs fuːd friː tuː traɪ/
dialogue.zh: 打擾一下，這些食物都能免費試吃嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, the samples? Yes, right down this row.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ðə ˈsæmpəlz jɛs raɪt daʊn ðɪs roʊ/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，試吃台喔？對，沿著這排走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Amazing. Can I grab a skewer myself?
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈmeɪzɪŋ kæn aɪ ɡræb ə ˈskjuːr maɪˈsɛlf/
dialogue.zh: 太棒了，我可以自己拿牙籤嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Go ahead, one each — I'm watching, ha.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡoʊ əˈhɛd wʌn iːtʃ aɪm ˈwɑːtʃɪŋ hɑː/
dialogue.zh: 請拿，一位一份——我可盯著喔，哈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fair enough! These chicken bites really rock.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɛr ɪˈnʌf ðiːz ˈtʃɪkɪn baɪts ˈrɪəli rɑːk/
dialogue.zh: 應該啦！這些雞粒也太好吃了吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right? We sell them in the giant tubs.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt wi sɛl ðɛm ɪn ðə ˈdʒaɪənt təbz/
dialogue.zh: 對吧？我們賣的是大桶裝的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ugh, do I really need forty pounds of cheese?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌɡ duː aɪ ˈrɪəli niːd ˈfɔːrti paʊndz əv tʃiːz/
dialogue.zh: 天，我真的需要四十磅起司嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Depends! Who's feeding you this week?
dialogue.zh: 看情況！這週是買給誰吃？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My whole team, actually, a potluck on Friday.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ hoʊl tiːm ˈæktʃuəli ə ˈpɑːtlʌk ɑːn ˈfraɪdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 說實話，是整個部門，週五要聚餐。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then the big box wins, trust me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ðə bɪɡ bɑːks wɪnz trʌst miː/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, can I shop without a membership today?
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt kæn aɪ ʃɑːp wɪˈðaʊt ə ˈmɛmbərʃɪp təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 等等，今天沒有會員卡也能逛嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can with a guest pass, front desk.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju kæn wɪð ə ɡɛst pæs frʌnt dɛsk/
dialogue.zh: 用一日來客證就行，入口櫃台領。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A guest pass? Where does one of those live?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ɡɛst pæs wɛr dʌz wʌn əv ðoʊz lɪv/
dialogue.zh: 來客證？那種東西要去哪裡領？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Free daily, three per family, first come basis.
dialogue.phonetic: /friː ˈdeɪli θriː pər ˈfæməli fɜːrst kʌm ˈbeɪsɪs/
dialogue.zh: 每天免費，一家三張，先到先得。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect timing, my sister's coming in Sunday.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜːrfɪkt ˈtaɪmɪŋ maɪ ˈsɪstərz ˈkʌmɪŋ ɪn ˈsʌndeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 時間剛巧，我姊星期日要來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Grab the pass, then swing by my booth.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡræb ðə pæs ðɛn swɪŋ baɪ maɪ buːθ/
dialogue.zh: 先領證，再順路來我這攤看看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Deal. Thanks for the snack tour, seriously!
dialogue.phonetic: /diːl θæŋks fɔːr ðə snæk tʊər səˈrɪəsli/
dialogue.zh: 說定了。謝謝你帶我試吃一圈！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Anytime! Try the mango stand when you're done.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛniˌtaɪm traɪ ðə ˈmæŋɡoʊ stænd wɛn juːr dʌn/
dialogue.zh: 不客氣！走之前記得試試芒果那攤。
